# Google Groups

> > A collaborative platform for creating, managing, and participating in email-based discussion groups and online communities.

Google Groups enables users to create mailing lists, discussion forums, and collaborative spaces for teams, communities, and organizations. The platform integrates with Google Suite and provides group management, privacy settings, content moderation, and community support features.

## Key Topics

- Group management and settings
- Privacy and permissions
- Content moderation and spam detection
- Authentication and access control
- Community forums and discussions
- Google Suite integration
- Group Policy Client service (Gpsvc)
- Email distribution lists
- User roles and membership
- Content warnings and policies
- Proxy and extension settings
- Forum moderation tools
- Group discovery and browsing

## Getting Started

- [Home Page - Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/home-page): Google Groups homepage with content policy and moderation info
- [My Groups - Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/my-groups): Personal groups dashboard for Google Groups users
- [About My Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/my-groups/about): About page for My Groups with settings and management info

## Group Settings & Management

- [About Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/googlegroups/about): Google Groups about page with privacy and group settings

## Community Support & Forums

- [Community Forums - Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/community-forums): Community forums listing for user support and discussion topics

## Optional

- [Opera Proxy Settings Discussion](https://groups.google.com/g/anticensority/c/aBfZaDUs3TE): Opera proxy settings troubleshooting for Anticensority extension
